latest.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains

latest.title: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
latest.description: France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.

latest.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
latest.description: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.
